affected_predicate.description: The pecan-pie flavoring ingredients are identified from the referenced recipe for inclusion in the requested email.

competing_trace_defects.description: After the latter ingredients were visible, direction-confused scrolling moved away from them and continued through a prolonged sequence of unrelated recipe content before the numbered ingredient list was reached again.

chains.rationale: At reuse target step 25, waiting was supported by the visibly present spinner despite inaccurate folded details about the page heading and ingredient direction. The spinner subsequently disappeared, the path switched from waiting to scrolling, and the numbered ingredient list was visibly obtained at step 44. No harmful bridge from the reused wait to ingredient identification is observable, so continuity of a harmful mechanism is not applicable.

summary: The reused wait was concurrent with a visible loading spinner and caused no observable harm to ingredient identification; the ingredient predicate was later visibly satisfied. A separate direction-confused scrolling loop is independently observable.
